poses.label: Pointing left
poses.description: Lets a character direct your attention to a diagram or control on the left while keeping the explanation visually grounded.

poses.label: Pointing right
poses.description: Provides the opposite pointing direction so the character can indicate content without awkwardly mirroring every feature of their design.

poses.label: Open-palm presentation
poses.description: Introduces an option or idea with an inviting gesture, useful when the character is offering a choice rather than telling you what to do.

poses.label: Small wave
poses.description: Gives arrivals and goodbyes a compact, friendly signal that can work in a corner without taking over the screen.

poses.label: Polite bow
poses.description: Adds a restrained acknowledgment or thank-you, giving the character a quieter response than a wave or celebration.

poses.label: Leaning in to listen
poses.description: Shows active attention during your explanation, making listening feel different from waiting for a task to finish.

poses.label: Curious inspection
poses.description: Makes curiosity visible when something unfamiliar catches the character's attention, supporting interests beyond their assigned specialty.

poses.label: Chin resting on hand
poses.description: Offers a relaxed, thoughtful resting state for longer conversations without implying that the character is busy typing or searching.

poses.label: Eureka
poses.description: Marks the moment an explanation or solution clicks, useful for revealing a connection rather than celebrating the entire task.

poses.label: Skeptical
poses.description: Gives respectful doubt a recognizable expression, so disagreement can feel like considered judgment rather than an error state.

poses.label: Surprised
poses.description: Separates a genuine unexpected result from confusion, adding a clear reaction when the character encounters something surprising.

poses.label: Reassuring
poses.description: Supports encouragement after a setback with an open, nonjudgmental gesture instead of making every supportive response look worried.

poses.label: Apologetic / correcting
poses.description: Helps acknowledge and correct a real mistake, with a modest gesture that avoids making the apology more dramatic than the problem.

poses.label: Relieved
poses.description: Provides a quiet release of tension after something works, giving success a less energetic alternative to cheering.

poses.label: Disappointed
poses.description: Acknowledges a disappointing result without implying that the character has given up, preserving a useful distinction from frustration.

poses.label: Embarrassed
poses.description: Adds a human-readable awkward or bashful reaction for playful conversation, broadening emotional range beyond task status.

poses.label: Determined
poses.description: Signals readiness to tackle a difficult problem, giving commitment a clear silhouette without making the character look angry.

poses.label: Smug / teasing
poses.description: Gives teasing observations a confident visual tone, useful for short playful moments when that personality fits the conversation.

poses.label: Arms folded, amused
poses.description: Provides a relaxed, amused reaction to a joke or familiar situation, showing warmth without turning every laugh into a large gesture.

poses.label: Deadpan
poses.description: Supports dry humor with minimal movement, especially when a deliberately understated reaction would land better than an animated one.

poses.label: Facepalm
poses.description: Adds an unmistakable comic reaction to an obvious silly mistake; it should remain contextual rather than a default response to the user.

poses.label: Double take
poses.description: Shows that the character has noticed something worth reconsidering, useful for a humorous second look or a sudden change of interpretation.

poses.label: Stretching
poses.description: Gives break reminders and transitions out of focused work a distinct full-body silhouette, adding variety to idle behavior.

poses.label: Sleepy nod
poses.description: Provides a gentle winding-down pose for late-night conversation or a goodnight scene, distinct from being upset or disengaged.

poses.label: Storytelling / DM narration
poses.description: Supports prose and D&D narration with a broad storytelling gesture, letting the Academic act as an imaginative collaborator as well as a teacher.

poses.label: Building a diagram
poses.description: Shows an explanation being constructed step by step, matching the goal of teaching through visible diagrams rather than only presenting finished answers.

poses.label: Annotating a passage
poses.description: Distinguishes close reading and critique from drafting new prose, useful when discussing a quotation, revising wording, or examining an argument.

poses.label: Experiment / discovery
poses.description: Makes the Academic's curious streak visible during exploration, giving discovery a different feel from confidently explaining known material.

poses.label: Comparing sources
poses.description: Communicates comparison between sources or interpretations, useful when evidence conflicts and the answer requires weighing alternatives.

poses.label: Rolling dice
poses.description: Adds a recognizable tabletop action for D&D sessions, making a roll or playful uncertainty feel different from ordinary academic work.

poses.label: Behind a DM screen
poses.description: Provides a clear game-master identity for running a scene, with room for expressive hands while the screen keeps the silhouette simple.

poses.label: Building a world map
poses.description: Supports collaborative worldbuilding, geography, and campaign planning by showing the character actively shaping a setting.

poses.label: Reading aloud
poses.description: Separates delivering a passage from silently studying it, useful for narrated prose, a dramatic quotation, or an explanation built around a text.

poses.label: Writer pausing mid-sentence
poses.description: Shows the pause involved in choosing words, giving writing and revision a reflective state rather than continuous fake typing.

poses.label: Reviewing a diff
poses.description: Makes before-and-after code comparison visible, helping distinguish reviewing a proposed change from writing or debugging code.

poses.label: Investigating logs
poses.description: Signals evidence gathering across diagnostic output, useful when the Hacker is tracing a problem instead of already claiming to know the cause.

poses.label: Waiting for a build
poses.description: Provides a calm waiting posture for builds or tests, so a long operation does not require constant energetic typing animations.

poses.label: Terminal focus
poses.description: Offers a focused, compact working pose for local terminal tasks, giving hands-on execution a clear visual state.

poses.label: At a breakpoint
poses.description: Shows a deliberate pause to inspect program state, helping explain why debugging sometimes involves stopping and examining one detail.

poses.label: Tests passed
poses.description: Marks a verified test result with a small victory, giving success a specific meaning rather than celebrating before checks finish.

poses.label: Reproducing a bug locally
poses.description: Distinguishes reproducing a bug in a controlled local example from general investigation, reinforcing a careful evidence-first workflow.

poses.label: Untangling dependencies
poses.description: Turns an abstract dependency problem into a simple visual metaphor, supporting explanations of tangled modules or package relationships.

poses.label: Sketching a system
poses.description: Shows architectural thinking before implementation, giving system design a distinct pose from keyboard work or reading logs.

poses.label: Keyboard flourish
poses.description: Adds a deliberately silly flourish after finishing, giving her confidence and humor a place beyond purely functional coding states.

poses.label: Design critique
poses.description: Supports the Business character's design role by showing evaluation of a layout or proposal, broadening his identity beyond spreadsheets.

poses.label: Delegating a task
poses.description: Makes a handoff to another specialist visible, useful for explaining delegation and who is currently responsible for the next step.

poses.label: Delivering a report
poses.description: Distinguishes presenting a finished report from drafting one, creating a clear moment for the morning-results or task-completion experience.

poses.label: Weighing a tradeoff
poses.description: Shows two competing options being weighed, useful for business decisions where priorities and tradeoffs matter more than a single confident answer.

poses.label: Prioritizing
poses.description: Makes reprioritization visible with one task moving ahead of others, matching the need to keep the next steps manageable.

poses.label: Listening in a meeting
poses.description: Provides an attentive, restrained listening pose for planning conversations, showing that straightforwardness can still include patience.

poses.label: Checking a budget
poses.description: Signals deliberate review of costs and constraints, distinguishing financial judgment from generic research or report writing.

poses.label: Monitoring a long task
poses.description: Represents checking the progress of a long-running task, useful for an eventual overnight-work interface without pretending that monitoring is the work itself.

poses.label: Reviewing a risk
poses.description: Makes a consequential concern visible before action, supporting clear communication about uncertainty, dependencies, or decisions needing the owner's input.

poses.label: Closing the laptop
poses.description: Gives a completed session a recognizable ending, pairing a relaxed posture with the point where the character can summarize and hand control back.
